SVBPH Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SVBPH Delhi Junior Resident (Dental) recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and the interview is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BDS Degree from a recognized University or Institute to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Resident (Dental) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident (Dental) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 56,100 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Resident (Dental) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the SVBPH Delhi Junior Resident (Dental) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Resident (Dental) post will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for SVBPH Delhi Junior Resident (Dental) recruitment held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel Hospital Delhi, New Delhi - 110008.

faq.question: Q10. What is the internship completion requirement for the Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed their internship within 02 years before the date of the interview, and not before 03.09.2024.
